items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: the only musicians I recall with Buddy Petit at the time was Edmund Hall on clarinet

ctx.x: Early 20s? And who were the people?

Well, the only musicians I recall with Buddy Petit at the time was Edmund Hall on clarinet and a George Washington on trombone. I think there have been several George Washington trombones. I can't tell you which one this was, but there was a George Washington on trombone. Short film? My memory's not good enough. I don't remember. Around the same time, I just mentioned two or three bands there, but there were bands such as, I believe, Silverleaf Band, the Tuxedo Band. And I'm quite sure that Punch Miller and Kid…
What did Buddy play in Mandeville? Would he play in a dance hall or in a pavilion?
